note: State Bank of India's Savings Bank Account page (rendered, read 29 October 2026): the account asks no monthly average balance, so carries no charge for falling below one; cheque books beyond the first ten leaves a year and free withdrawals limited by the balance aren't modelled.

sources.title: State Bank of India, Savings Bank Account
sources.said: First 10 cheque leaves free in a financial year ... Restricted free withdrawals based on Monthly Average Balance maintained. ... Monthly Average Balance: NIL ... No limit on Maximum balance
